name: Dennis Kaberuka
bio:
Group General Counsel at Crystal Ventures Limited · An experienced Corporate Lawyer with over 10 years of working experience. At Crystal Ventures Limited Group, KABERUKA is tasked with; developing the legal services strategy for the Group, advising on transactions, undertaking quarterly legal audits to ensure compliance, drafting of company contracts & correspondences, board secretarial duties, property conveyance, and overall advisory on corporate & commercial law.

Prior to joining Crystal Ventures Limited, KABERUKA worked at Rwanda's leading passive  telecommunications infrastructure provider 'IHS Rwanda Ltd' deputizing in the Legal Affairs department where he advised on the acquisition of the tower assets of MTN Rwandacell Ltd and the entire shareholding of Rwanda Towers Ltd (formerly a subsidiary of Airtel Rwanda Ltd). 

KABERUKA holds a bachelors degree in law from the University of Rwanda 'NUR', a Post Graduate Diploma in Legal Practice from the Institute of Legal Practice
